Matt also stabilized JP Morgan's Asset Management Salesforce rollout, aligning regional stakeholders on a single roadmap and ensuring compliance across jurisdictions. This project spanned **12 countries** and resulted in a 3× increase in tracked sales opportunities. Furthermore, he rescued and stabilized the Dynamics CRM program for Treasury & Securities Services, transitioning the delivery model and executing a full knowledge transfer to JP Morgan's internal team.
